_note: Social announcements that are not articles. The auto-poster (scripts/social_post.py) posts one per brand per run (every 30 min), photo + caption to Facebook and Instagram, then logs it in social-posted.json under 'queue'. Optional: not_before (UTC, YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM), facebook/instagram false to skip one. Photos must be public JPGs; Instagram needs 4:5 to 1.91:1. Optional: video (public 1080x1920 MP4 URL) posts a Reel to Instagram and a video to Facebook; image is then used as the Reel cover.
